messages:
Raj: opened PR for narrowing the service-account scope + change to how we mount secrets for on-prem agents — https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4821. tagging sec for onprem implications, especially token projection and CI artifact access.

Sophia: looking now. quick note — this touches the init sidecar that fetches creds, right? want to confirm we don't revert to long-lived tokens.

Raj: correct, it swaps the long-lived token path with token projection + short-lived Vault lease. main concerns: (1) Vault policy minimality, (2) sidecar retry behavior in air-gapped nets, (3) CI runner permissions for building the agent image.

security-bot: Automated checklist: vault-policy-scan: PASS; public-credential-exposure: WARN (see comment); kms-usage: RECORD_FOUND.

Maria: @Raj please add the Vault policy diff in the PR description — makes review faster. Also include the `kubectl` snippet we'll use for the staging smoke so sec can reproduce.

Raj: added policy diff and smoke commands. snippet in PR: ```sh
# run in staging cluster
kubectl apply -f test-secret-projection.yaml
kubectl rollout restart deploy/onprem-agent
# verify pod has token projected
kubectl exec -it deploy/onprem-agent -- cat /var/run/secrets/token | head -n1
```

Dave: quick question on egress — will the agent need to call out to public Vault endpoints? If so, need an allowlist for onprem firewall rules or a proxy plan.

Raj: goal is to use customer-managed Vault endpoints inside VPC when private; fallback to Redwood-managed Vault for hosted. For onprem installs the default is customer Vault, but the code also attempts Redwood-managed if not configured. I can gate the fallback behind a feature flag if that helps.

Olivia: please gate the fallback. We had an incident last year where a fallback caused unexpected egress in an air-gapped customer. Also, document the required firewall ports in the README.

Sophia: security review notes — 1) require feature-flag default OFF for fallback; 2) ensure client cert verification is enforced for Vault TLS; 3) add a short-lived lease failure mode that causes agent to run in read-only (no secret writes) and emit a metric.

Raj: good catches. I'll flip the fallback to opt-in and add cert verification. For the read-only failure mode, do we have an existing metric name?

Maria: use `agent.secret_lease.fail_mode` — we already wire that into alerts. Add a debug log line with lease id masked.

Dave: CI change — the new build step needs access to the artifact bucket. Can we scope the CI SA to only the `image-build:write` role instead of full storage admin?

Raj: yes, I'll trim to `image-build:write` and add comment in PR about service account scoping.

security-bot: Remediation reminders: add documentation for firewall allowlist, add feature-flag gate, mask logs, and limit CI SA perms.

Olivia: for merge timing — I can run a staging smoke test tomorrow morning (Mon 09:00 PT) if everyone LGTM. Maria, can you run the sec checklist during the smoke?

Maria: I can. schedule works for me. I'll verify policy diff and run the vault cert check.

Sophia: LGTM pending the small changes Raj listed (feature-flag opt-in, cert enforcement, masked log).

Raj: thanks. I'll push commits this evening. holding merge until staging smoke + sec checklist pass. target merge window Tue 22:00 UTC.

Olivia: sounds good. keep the PR open and ping here when it's ready for final scan. :thumbsup:

Raj: will do — thanks all.
